headline: Canadian Home Sales Edge Up 0.3% in October, Down 10.6% Year-on-Year
summary: Canadian national home sales edged 0.3% higher month-over-month in October according to CREA, while unadjusted sales fell 10.6% on an annual basis amid higher borrowing costs.
why: Real estate is a major component of Canadian GDP, sensitive to Bank of Canada interest rate decisions and mortgage renewals.

impacts.name: S&P/TSX Composite
impacts.why: Muted home sales growth of 0.3% underscores ongoing housing market stagnation.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h
